acceptance: Automated Cleanup introduces zero word fusions and zero unauthorized source-projection loss.
join_without_space is removed; only validated dehyphenate and join_preserving_hyphen transformations may remove boundary whitespace.
Every boundary has one typed resolution, including semantic line breaks; no newline remains unclassified.
Native structure is authoritative, roles precede boundary decisions, and page-artifact removal cannot concatenate body units.
Cleanup completes deterministically without a usable LLM and isolates provider failures per batch.
LLM batching adapts to context, splits until fit, uses strict output, and verifies prior overrides.
cleanup.json checkpoints analysis and adjudication; compatible resume skips work and model/context/prompt changes redo only AI decisions.
Only completed metadata with matching output hash is consumable; finalization recovery rerenders without LLM.
Manual edits retain truthful structure/provenance and invalidate downstream work.
The existing Cleanup UI layout and controls remain; new state is shown through the existing progress dialog and status pane.
Chunking prioritizes semantic cuts, avoids mid-sentence cuts except unavoidable overflow, and treats size balance as soft.
Benchmark results are zero of the measured 36 fusions remaining, 27/27 page transitions resolved, and paragraph F1 at least 0.97.
Focused/full pytest and ruff gates pass; no commit, push, PR, or merge is performed.
assumptions: Supported content languages are en, ro, de, fr, ru, pt, es, and it; dominant CJK or Hangul content is rejected.
cleanup.json is checkpoint and final metadata; clean_text.txt is the only text output; no schema version or migration branch remains.
The existing Cleanup UI layout and controls remain visually unchanged.
open_questions: Approve the high-risk replacement of the Cleanup persistence contract and its cross-component Chunking integration under the accepted no-compatibility plan?
alignment.reason: Repository policy requires a human checkpoint because the approved plan replaces durable contracts across two high-criticality components.
recommended_responses: Approved: continue gate-by-gate through delivery without publication; preserve the current UI layout and leave final interactive testing to the user.
scope: In scope: eight-language configuration, Cleanup analysis/rendering/quality/LLM/persistence/resume/manual edits, existing Cleanup UI integration, and Chunking consumption of roles and semantic boundaries. Out of scope: new UI controls/pages, CJK/Hangul support, image-only PDF OCR, prior Cleanup compatibility or migration, commits, pushes, PRs, merges, and operator acceptance testing.

intent.statement: Rebuild Cleanup V2 and its Chunking integration around deterministic structural analysis, zero introduced word fusion, one resumable cleanup.json contract, bounded model-agnostic LLM adjudication, semantic line breaks, eight supported languages, and the existing Cleanup UI.

examples: Dropping a page number between two body units retains a typed separator.
spec_items.statement: Automated Cleanup preserves lexical projection and introduces no alphanumeric fusion.

examples: civil- plus defense becomes civil-defense; ordinary valid plus words retains a space.
spec_items.statement: Only source-validated hyphen transformations may remove boundary whitespace.

examples: Verse lines use semantic_line_break; prose continuation uses join_with_space.
spec_items.statement: Every non-terminal source boundary receives one typed final choice, confidence, and reason-code set.

examples: A dropped page number cannot erase the decision between the surrounding body units.
spec_items.statement: Native structure and detected roles precede deterministic boundary and page-transition decisions.

examples: No profile, a 9B profile without structured output, or a failed provider still yields validated output.
spec_items.statement: Cleanup completes from deterministic priors whenever strict LLM adjudication is unavailable.

examples: A 16K profile starts at four questions and an oversized batch splits recursively.
spec_items.statement: Cleanup batches structured adjudication by context and verifies every proposed prior override.

examples: Changing model context preserves deterministic analysis and clears all AI answers.
spec_items.statement: Cleanup checkpoints one document and invalidates only the deterministic or AI layer made incompatible at resume.

examples: A paused document with an old clean_text.txt is rejected by Chunking.
spec_items.statement: Only a completed hash-matching Cleanup output is consumable and finalization recovery is LLM-free.

examples: A lexical edit produces user_edited paragraph records with unknown provenance where alignment fails.
spec_items.statement: Manual Cleanup edits rebuild truthful structure and invalidate downstream state.

examples: The current Cleanup button resumes paused work; no new button or pre-flight dialog appears.
spec_items.statement: Cleanup quality and resume state fit the existing page, dialog, status pane, and edit controls.

examples: A scene separator outranks size balance even when adjacent chunks differ in length.
spec_items.statement: Chunking prioritizes typed semantic boundaries and uses mid-sentence fallback only for unavoidable single-sentence overflow.

examples: Command Performance reaches 27 of 27 correct page transitions.
spec_items.statement: The deterministic oracle meets the measured benchmark and format-specific structure thresholds.
spec_items.threshold: benchmark F1>=0.97; native F1>=0.99; good-geometry F1>=0.95

examples: pytest and ruff pass; Git has no commit or push produced by this run.
spec_items.statement: The implementation passes focused and full automated gates without publication.

examples: Narrative A / * * * / Narrative B produces two narratable chunks and no marker text.
spec_items.statement: Chunking treats recognized scene-separator artifacts as non-narratable hard boundaries, omits them from generated chunk text, and emits no separator-only chunk.

examples: Narrative A / * * * / Narrative B marks only the Narrative B chunk true.
spec_items.statement: Every narratable chunk persists whether it starts after one or more omitted scene separators.

examples: Deleting a marked chunk transfers its leading scene boundary to the next surviving chunk.
spec_items.statement: Manual Chunking edits and deletions preserve leading scene-separator boundary metadata.

examples: A paragraph containing only * * * becomes scene_separator; ... remains body.
spec_items.statement: User-edited Cleanup reconstruction classifies conservative explicit scene-separator forms without promoting ambiguous punctuation.
